Mother’s Day is often about celebrating others, but more moms are choosing to celebrate themselves too. One of the most popular ways they’re doing that is through SkinPen® microneedling, a treatment that delivers real results without surgery or long recovery times. At AestheticEye, serving Cincinnati and Dayton from our Springboro, OH clinic, we help patients achieve smoother, more radiant skin with this advanced treatment.

A Growing Trend in Self-Care

Today’s moms are busier than ever, balancing careers, family, and everything in between. That’s why many are choosing treatments that are effective but fit into their schedules.

Non-surgical procedures have surged in popularity, with millions of minimally invasive treatments performed each year in the U.S. Microneedling, in particular, has become a top choice for those looking to refresh their skin without downtime.

What Is SkinPen® Microneedling?

SkinPen® is the first FDA-cleared microneedling device, clinically proven to improve the appearance of fine lines, acne scars, and overall skin texture.

Unlike more aggressive treatments, SkinPen works with your body’s natural processes to rejuvenate the skin from within.

How SkinPen® Works

SkinPen uses tiny, controlled micro-injuries to stimulate the skin’s natural healing response. While this may sound intense, the process is precise and safe when performed by trained professionals.

This controlled stimulation encourages the production of:

  • Collagen, which gives skin structure and firmness
  • Elastin, which helps skin remain smooth and flexible

As new collagen forms, the skin becomes firmer, more even, and more youthful-looking over time.

The Science Behind the Glow

Collagen production naturally declines with age, contributing to wrinkles and skin laxity. Studies show that collagen levels decrease by about 1% per year after your 20s.

By stimulating collagen production, SkinPen helps reverse some of these effects, restoring a more youthful appearance without artificial fillers or drastic changes.

What Results Can You Expect?

SkinPen microneedling is known for delivering gradual, natural improvements.

Patients often notice:

  • Smoother skin texture
  • Reduction in fine lines and wrinkles
  • Improvement in acne scars
  • Brighter, more even skin tone

Many people begin to see visible improvement within a week, with continued enhancement over several months as collagen production increases. Most patients benefit from a series of three treatments spaced about four weeks apart, with maintenance sessions helping extend results.

Why Moms Love SkinPen®

One of the biggest reasons SkinPen is so popular among moms is its convenience. There’s minimal downtime, and treatments can often be scheduled around busy routines.

Key benefits include:

  • Non-surgical and minimally invasive
  • Little to no downtime
  • Safe for a variety of skin types
  • Natural-looking results

It’s an ideal “Mother’s Day gift” that keeps delivering benefits long after the treatment.

Expert Care You Can Trust

At AestheticEye, treatments are performed under the guidance of Dr. Jonathan Pargament, a board-certified oculoplastic surgeon serving patients in Cincinnati and Dayton.

Dr. Pargament’s expertise ensures that each treatment is performed with precision and care, delivering results that are both effective and natural-looking.

A Gift That’s Truly for You

Mother’s Day is the perfect time to focus on self-care. Whether you’re looking to refresh your skin or address specific concerns, SkinPen microneedling offers a powerful yet gentle solution. With proven results and minimal downtime, it’s no surprise more moms are choosing this treatment.

Contact AestheticEye in Springboro, OH, today to schedule your consultation and discover how SkinPen can help you achieve smoother, healthier, and more youthful skin.
